title: Naturality of the canonical mixed total-complex associator
statement: Let $R,A$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure on $A$. Let $T$ be total tensor over $A$ and $S$ mixed total tensor with the $A$-action on its first factor [def-pc-mixed-total-tensor]. For triples $X,Y$ of two unbounded $A$-complexes and one unbounded $R$-complex and a triple of chain maps $f:X\to Y$, let $a_X$ denote the canonical chain associator obtained from the ordinary module associator by Mathlib's total bifunctor construction [lem-pc-kflat-total-tensor-associativity]. Set $L_c(X)=S(T(X_1,X_2),X_3)$ and $U_c(X)=T(X_1,S(X_2,X_3))$. Then $L_c(f);a_Y=a_X;U_c(f)$. No K-flatness or boundedness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Construct the module rebracketing isomorphism, natural in the three modules, with extension of scalars in the R-module argument. Apply Mathlib mapBifunctorAssociator to obtain the chain isomorphism and its triple summand equation.

In each degree the triple summand inclusions jointly determine maps, since tensoring with a fixed A-module preserves coproducts. Precompose the naturality equation with each summand inclusion. The chain maps act by their three degreewise components. The associator acts by ordinary rebracketing. Module associator naturality equates the resulting composites. Equality in every degree proves equality of chain maps. The construction already commutes with differentials; no boundedness is used.
